messages:
jen-support: Customer (ACME) reports SSE stream cutting off ~70-90s, client reconnect loop and large billing spike. Repro path: Cloudflare -> ALB -> nginx (our gateway). They provided pcap + gateway logs.

sam: Any error lines in the gateway/nginx logs or tcp fin?

jen-support: Pasted the key bits from the gateway log below:

[Gateway] conn=abc123 stream.flush start -> 72.4s
STATUS=499 client closed request
X-Trace: rid-202-zzz
nginx: send() returned 32, Resource temporarily unavailable

anya: 499 means client closed, but timing ~72s is interesting. Cloudflare default edge timeout is ~100s, ALB default idle is 60s, nginx proxy_read_timeout often 60s. 72s sits between those — could be interaction between rate limiting and TCP buffers causing stall then client gives up.

mike: @anya Cloudflare 100s, ALB 60s, nginx 60s typical. But customer says ~75-80s consistently. Another suspect: per-connection token bucket rate-limit on the ALB/WAF + our per-connection soft limit. If the token bucket schedules a refill that blocks writes, it can create head-of-line backpressure so the connection stalls until a timeout.

jen-support: They said ALB has a WAF rule doing "requests per IP" and our gateway also applies per-connection rate limiting for long-lived streams. They saw the stream produce partial chunks then nothing then client reconnect. Billing spike because each reconnect resumed and produced additional tokens.

sam: Can we reproduce? I'll spin up a staging CF worker + ALB + nginx origin mimic and enable per-conn ratelimit in nginx. Need concrete steps.

jen-support: Repro steps customer provided (condensed):

curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://staging.gateway/redwood/stream?prompt=test" -H "Authorization: Bearer RWD_TEST" --max-time 300

nginx snippet they run:
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_read_timeout 90;
proxy_send_timeout 90;
sendfile off;

ALB idle timeout: 60s
Cloudflare edge timeout: 100s
Our runtime shows send() EAGAIN near 72s.

anya: Try these during repro:
- Ensure proxy_buffering off (they did).
- Enable explicit SSE heartbeat (SSE comment lines like ":\n\n" every 15-20s).
- Set ALB idle timeout > Cloudflare (so origin doesn't close before CF).
- Disable per-connection rate limits and use per-route/global limits instead.

mike: Head-of-line hypothesis: when a per-connection token bucket blocks writes for that TCP connection, the kernel send buffer fills and subsequent write() returns EAGAIN. nginx surfaces that as send() returned 32. If ALB or CF then times out the connection (or the client reconnects), we see partial output. Also if the edge sends TCP keepalive probes differently, timings can slip into that 70-80s window.

jen-support: Customer tried heartbeat once (every 30s) and proxy_buffering off; still saw one truncation. They can flip ALB idle to 240s if we confirm it's safe. They want quick mitigations while we root cause.

sam: I'll reproduce with:
- Staging CF + ALB with ALB idle=60 and ALB idle=240 tests
- nginx with per-connection rate limit enabled/disabled
- send SSE heartbeat every 15s vs none
- capture pcap + gateway trace and runtime traces

mike: For mitigation playbook I propose: 1) bypass per-conn rate-limit for that client IP (WAF exception) temporarily; 2) set ALB idle timeout to 240s (customer approved); 3) enable SSE heartbeat every 15s; 4) ensure proxy_buffering off and tcp_nodelay on; 5) move rate-limiting to per-route/global token bucket.

anya: Also add a diagnostic header from gateway for future traces: X-RW-Stream-Last-Write and X-RW-Conn-SendErr to capture last write time and EAGAIN occurrences; include that in support logs so we can correlate.

jen-support: Assigning to @sam to own the reproduce and collect traces. @mike will prepare mitigation steps and a short runbook we can share with the customer. I'll update support ticket #12345 and ask customer to keep us on the line during the ALB timeout test.

mike: I'll draft the runbook and test the ALB change in staging, then post commands and config diffs.

jen-support: Thanks all. Will update customer after first reproduce confirmation. :thumbsup:
